title: Accessibility & i18n readiness audit — Dashboards, Rollouts, Cost Views (prototype review)
creator: Mariana Gomez
description: Objective: Run a focused accessibility and internationalization readiness pass on the Redwood Console UIs for dashboards, rollout pages, and cost views. Deliverables: annotated prototype screens, a prioritized WCAG fix list with estimated engineering effort, a keyboard-navigation spec, color-contrast token adjustments, and i18n readiness notes (RTL, plurals, date/currency formats, truncation). Background: During the Console UX Refresh design sprint we surfaced a number of accessibility and localization risks in user testing and engineering reviews. This ticket consolidates those items, formalizes acceptance criteria, and stages a lightweight prototype review with frontend engineers and PM for early implementation alignment.
comments: 2026-02-26 - Mariana: Initial combined audit exported from Axure -> Figma. Found low-contrast token usage in the 'cost breakdown' sparkline and several truncated labels in the 'routes' table when locale is fr-FR.

2026-02-28 - Ayesha: Added keyboard nav flow for Dashboards list + drilldown. Noted that modal focus trap currently returns focus to body instead of the calling button on close (observed in prototype).

2026-03-03 - Liam Chen (Engineering): Prototype ARIA roles look good; concerned about perf of live announcements for high-frequency cost updates — suggested debounce strategy and a11y-friendly politeness settings.
2026-03-05 - PM (Ethan Price): Prioritize rollout pages and billing/cost views for this milestone; dashboards can be staged in a follow-up if engineering capacity is constrained.

2026-03-08 - Accessibility consultant (external): Recommend 4.5:1 contrast for small UI labels and 3:1 for large text, add skip-to-main link on global nav, add visible focus states for interactive SVG buttons.

2026-03-10 - Ayesha: Updated prototype with RTL mirroring for the Rollouts page and sample locale strings demonstrating pluralization edge cases. Marking this In Review and requesting ENG + PM sign-off on feasibility notes.
2026-03-10 - Mariana: Uploaded acceptance checklist and links to Confluence doc + GitHub PR template for a11y fixes.
acceptance_criteria: Annotated Figma prototype pages for Dashboards, Rollouts, and Cost Views with WCAG 2.1 AA issues flagged and proposed fixes
Keyboard navigation spec covering tab order, focus trapping, skip links, and arrow-key interactions for tables and charts
Color token recommendations with scoped contrast ratios and updated token names for handoff

i18n readiness notes including: placeholder expansion guidelines, RTL layout mirroring examples, date/time/currency formatting recommendations, and a list of strings requiring ICU/pluralization handling
Engineering feasibility notes and a prioritized implementation backlog with rough estimates (P0/P1/P2 split)
Sign-off from ENG (Liam Chen) and PM (Ethan Price) documented in comments
links: GitHub PR template for a11y fixes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/
